verdict.rationale: Square documents an official Mobile Payments SDK (square-docs-4) with platform-specific iOS docs (Tap to Pay on iPhone, square-docs-2) and Android docs (Offline Payments, square-docs-5). Tap to Pay on iPhone accepts contactless cards and digital wallets in person (square-docs-1), so embedding in-person payments in your own iOS or Android app is clearly supported. The evidence consists mostly of page titles and URLs. missing for 10: in-depth SDK documentation detail (setup, card-reader pairing, supported payment flows), independent or hands-on corroboration of integrating the SDK.
